rca of the issue: User-reported 'phantom approval prompts on both devices' RCA: previous threshold (3min) + lack of explicit liveness ping meant any tab that had been opened in the last 3 minutes — even one closed minutes ago — kept its last_seen_at fresh through the cached /auth/me call. With iter68: (a) explicit /auth/heartbeat fires every 30s only from open tabs, (b) threshold tightened to 60s so a closed tab is stale 60s after its last ping, (c) backfill (-2h on 105 sessions) cleans the historical fresh-but-abandoned rows. End result: tab closed ⇒ no ping ⇒ stale in 60s ⇒ no phantom prompt on the next login.
